name: Quality Inn & Suites Lake Havasu City

snippets.author: Gloria Newsom
snippets.text:
This is a very large place with many guests. They should have DOUBLED the number of breakfast workers. The short time we were in the breakfast room with windows, they repeatedly ran out of plates, plastic ware, coffee, and juice. There were no plastic knives, peanut butter, oatmeal, prunes, or yogurt. The waffle maker was a good idea, but was poorly placed in the middle and caused a bottle neck in the lines. There should be another location, cart, or signage for trash cans and dish pans so customers could clear their own tables. There just wasn't a "system" in place.

Heated pool was a nice idea, but nobody at the desk knew the temperature of the water and there was not a hot tub available. Needless to say, the fenced pool area was completely empty.

The front desk staff were young and new (in training), but seemed quite intelligent and spoke professionally. The adult trainer, on the other hand, was very negative, spoke derogatorily toward coworkers, and repeatedly panicked about her coworkers in training. We felt sorry for the new employees.

snippets.author: Kris K
snippets.text:
HORRIBLE experience. We booked a block of rooms together and upon checking in, we got different room rates. Upon trying to shorten a stay by one night 2 days in advance of the would be night stay, I was told that they could not give a refund for one night because I had signed a waiver at the beginning said I would pay for the whole trip, but they would put in the request. I followed up two days, and was told the request was declined by the owner, but when asking why, they gave no reason, but told me the iPad I signed wasn’t to pay the whole trip, but rather to confirm my information. So I asked her to confirm that the reason I am not getting a refund is because they don’t want to and for no other reason. She would not acknowledge the reason, and then when questioned about the difference in rates, she said her system wouldn’t give a reason (even though the rooms were the same size, floor, view, and booked as a block at the same time). At this point she asked me to leave the front desk as this was harassment.

Overall horrible stay for my family and myself for my aunt’s celebration of life. This was just the service, let alone the dirty rooms, blood and dirt found on pillow cases and towels in our newly checked in rooms, and delays of an hour checking in for my aunt and uncle due to workers not being able to get into the system. My aunt overheard a worker even recommending a different hotel because this place isn’t worth it.

I recommend sleeping in your car over signing up for this headache of a hotel. I hope talking with the manager in the morning helps get me at least some answers for some of the differences.

snippets.author: Ed
snippets.text: Our room was clean, it was a weird room where it was a room with the adjoining room through the door, like a suite.   One room had the beds gone and a tv and couch, other room was normal hotel room.  We both had our own bathroom.  It was noisy. The garbage truck dumped the gas station garbage dumpster at 6:30 am.  The road noise.   The breakfast was ok.

snippets.author: detroit proper
snippets.text:
It’s a 3 with positives.

The good. Firm bed was as good of a nights sleep as I had in this 2 week trip.
Fridge, microwave and bathtub in room. No issues with parking. Friendly staff at desk and mother daughter working the bar. Great view even though I couldn’t see the bridge.

The bad. Dirty bed, towels, even chairs at breakfast were dirty.
Comp’d dinner and breakfast were both very bad. Couldn’t take more than a lone bite of those eggs. What was that taste?
Oh and first room I’ve ever stayed with no soap or shampoo, but there was lotion conditioner and make up remover. Toilet sits very low. Your boys will get a swim. Some traffic noise might bother some guests.

snippets.author: Mike Mckenzie
snippets.text:
Absolutely the worst night I have ever spent in a hotel! The location is top notch. The staff are friendly. But the room. . .
The place is huge, but very dated. We could hear the traffic on the street about 50 yards away; not barely hear either. I said the place is huge. There are several buildings, each separated by a breeze way. Our room was located in the breeze way and when ever anyone walked through, talking/yelling, the echoes blasted into our room.
More than one group "partied they're way through the breeze way without apparent regard for other guests.
My sister and brother in law stayed on the level below us. Apparently a couple of families were having a fight fight outside their room resulting in yelling and arguing late into the night.

snippets.author: Ryan Smith
snippets.text: The room was good during our stay. However, we never received room service during our stay. When we called the front desk asked if we could have room service he stated that the staff left at 3pm and we could come down to get new towels for the room. We requested that towels be brought up instead and they complied. When we asked why service wasn't completed during our stay, they said we refused the services. This couldn't be true as we were not in the room at the time of cleaning to be able to refuse services. We were also told by others in our group that they also never received room service. Other than these issues our stay was good and this is a nice hotel in Lake Havasu. Most of the front desk staff was great as well as the food service staff during breakfast.

snippets.author: Elijah Clark
snippets.text: I took a weekend trip out here. And honestly this hotel was pretty good check in was smooth they have a functioning pool and jacuzzi tub and the view from the back of the hotel was spectacular! They have a great breakfast selection hot meals included! I didn’t have any issues with my room at all it was clean and spacious plus my bed was extra comfy didn’t want to leave out of it during checkout. Also the staff was very courtesy and kind during my stay. Very good location with walkable restaurants and other activities nearby and close to the main highway. Only complaint is the elevators not working but I’m sure it’ll get fixed. But other than that I’ll be sure to come back to this hotel on my next visit.

snippets.author: Connie Holden
snippets.text: Staff is very friendly and helpful.  We literally ran away from another hotel due to bugs in the room, and the girl at the desk made sure our room was available way before 3:00pm. The room is clean and spacious with comfortable beds. The location to the Rockabilly Reunion and the lake is nice too.

snippets.author: M B
snippets.text: Very nice place to stay. We booked another hotel sight unseen and didn't want to stay there. The staff at the Hampton advised us what we needed to do and then booked two rooms for us. Nice free breakfast, complementary coffee and hot water in the lobby. Lobby has various sections for nice gatherings. Our stay was great!

snippets.author: Shawn Murphy
snippets.text:
Dated rooms. Not bad but not great. Shower was good. Really good. Nice water pressure super hot and water didn’t back up in tub. Good location not far from fun stuff.

But. There is a beer can behind the bed. It ain’t mine. Thanks Hampton Inn. Otherwise room ok. But that damn beer can turns me off greatly.

Would I recommend ? Not sure. You take from this what you will.

name: Days Inn by Wyndham Lake Havasu

snippets.author: Billy Klingensmith
snippets.text:
⭐ Review: Days Inn by Wyndham Lake Havasu
If you’re looking for a stay in Lake Havasu that’s comfortable without being flashy, Days Inn by Wyndham fits the bill. It’s a bit of a quaint hole‑in‑the‑wall—nothing over the top, but that’s part of its charm.

- Location: Conveniently close to the London Bridge and local restaurants, so you’re never far from the action.
- Atmosphere: Simple, cozy, and unpretentious. It doesn’t try to be a resort, but it delivers on the basics.
- Rooms: Clean and functional, with everything you need for a short stay. Think more “practical stopover” than “luxury getaway.”
- Service: Friendly staff who keep things running smoothly without fuss.

Overall, it’s a good spot if you want a reliable stay in Lake Havasu without breaking the bank. Not glamorous, but it has that understated, tucked‑away feel that makes it a solid choice.

snippets.author: James Girod
snippets.text: Stayed 2 nights with my spouse and dog. Pet fee is $20 a night. The staff were satisfactory. The location is great. On the main road and 2 blocks from the London Bridge and the water front. Breakfast was pretty good. That said its kind of a dirty place. Run down looking. Didnt sleep good at all. The cheap price is not worth the sacrifice of cleanliness and comfort.

snippets.author: Shawn Reese
snippets.text: Location & price  was the reason we chose this motel but will not be staying here again for many reasons. The room was pretty spacious but extremely run down and the bedding was a joke. Fitted sheets were too small so we struggled to keep them on the mattress all night &  the tiny “throw” pillows that they used as sleeping pillows were laughable. Towels were hard and scratchy and no hot water in the wayyyyy too tall sink. The paper thin walls were the cherry on the top as all we heard was the toaster & waffle iron dings from the breakfast bar in the room next to us. The “drapes” don’t cover the window so we had light beaming in our room ALL NIGHT from the lights outside. Will not be staying here again, was not a good experience!!

snippets.author: Monty Morrow
snippets.text: Rented this place because of the price and it had a hot tub. Hot tub was cold. My room had a bathtub. I have a sore back so I kind of depend on soaking so I thought at least I have a bathtub in my room. No hot water. I was there three days in a row. Never any hot water in the bathtub. Also, it was a week of bad weather in Lake Havasu actually cold outside. The heater in my room never worked either. So that’s about it. Do not stay here. It’s not worth the $10 a night cheaper price. And it’s not the cheapest place to stay In Havasu but it is the medium price but pick a different place. You will not be happy with this place at all. Oh also made service is horrible behind the furniture in my room. There was leftover food. God knows how long it’s been there. The smell of marijuana outside permeating into my room was horrible.Again, don’t stay here

snippets.author: SRA Adamson
snippets.text: Our first clue should have been that there were alot of people just sitting outside of their room smoking. Second clue was the bed skirt was all cockeyed. I always check the mattresses when I check into a hotel. This place was no different EXCEPT that there were signs of bedbugs on the lower boxspring. It did have a wrap around it but all along the zipper in the right top corner were signs that they were either treated already or live. I didn’t stick around to find out. We booked another room somewhere else and left. I’m curious about all the reviews that said this place was wonderful.

snippets.author: Christine McGowan
snippets.text: We were in town for the Hot Rodz car show. Normally we would stay at the host hotel, but we were in town a couple weeks before the show and stopped in at this hotel. The front desk clerk was very friendly and upbeat. She gave us all the pertinent information for a reservation and we reserved the room that day. Pre check in was a breeze and when we arrived all we needed to do was pick up the key. We were given the first floor room we had requested (note there is no elevator) and were very close to the lobby and breakfast area. The room was great!  Very clean and spacious. No desk or comfy chair, but a small table and two dining chairs which worked out well. The bathroom was wonderful. Best shower I’ve had in a while. The room was quiet, the staff was more than pleasant and helpful. Breakfast was standard fare. Eggs and sausage, cereal, oatmeal packets, good coffee, juices. Some yogurt and fruit would be nice, but it was adequate. I’m very happy we decided to stay here instead of the host hotel. Much better choice.

snippets.author: WOW ENTERTAINMENT WEDDING DJS & EVENT LIGHTING INC
snippets.text: Great modern room.  Outstanding staff.  Friendly and helpful.  Very accommodating.  I had a nice lake view from my room.  Will definitely be staying here again.  I come to lake Havasu every year for the rockabilly reunion event.  Highly recommend!  A special thanks to "O" who helped me get checked in and really took good care of me.  She is a gem!

snippets.author: Debbie K
snippets.text:
The room, clean with a compfy king bed, new bathroom, nice TV, good view. A/C was perfect. The location was perfect! The staff were amazing!  Breakfast was eggs, sausage and waffles, cereal, begals, bread, juice, coffee, tea and milk. And prives perfect!
Totally going to return!

snippets.author: jodi Hudson
snippets.text: Please let the hotel know if you have a pet . My husband is in a wheelchair and I reserved an Accessible Room to accommodate him . I called the morning of arrival to let them know we had a dog and he said ok and thank you for letting them know . 10 minutes later they called me back and said that they don't have a accessible room available , even though I already booked it . They moved me to a regular room because of my pet and he cannot get his wheelchair into the bathroom. So, yes , it makes things more difficult .  I told them if my dog was a service dog they would have to allow the dog in the accessible toom and she told me the wouldn't because a handicapped room should be sanitary for a handicapped person . So , of course I looked it up and of course a service dog CAN be in a room that is not for pets and also cannot charge a fee for cleaning .  My dog is not a service dog though. The room is nice, looks newly remodeled, and is clean . Stay is good with exception of no accessible pet rooms .

snippets.author: Black Prospector
snippets.text:
Great location, room was fine for what we needed (I had stayed there before), but Ophelia at the front desk was simply amazing. She was fun to talk to at the check-in and definitely made us feel welcome.

The only reason I took the location down a star was because of what happened at breakfast the next morning. I walked to the lobby, said "good morning" to receptionist at the front desk and went to heat up my breakfast from the prior day that was in a typical "go box" from a restaurant. The receptionist walked up to me and stated, "Are you heating up my food?" I thought that perhaps she had some food sitting out and she thought I mistakenly heated it up if she left it around there or something. But I jokingly said, "No, that's my breakfast, but the pancakes were so good, I'll share them with you if you like."

It wasn't until I sat down that I realized she actually came in there to ask me that, and then I was baffled as to how she could think that I had "her food". Did I sneak into the employee area, grab her Styrofoam container, speak to her and walk in and try to eat it? I was dressed pretty well (actually the best dressed person in the breakfast area) so it was quite baffling. I don't want to make another assumption (as only she knows right?)

Overall, Ophelia was such a delight, that even her coworker could not spoil the great impression she made.

snippets.author: Gracie Rojo
snippets.text:
We really enjoyed our stay at Crazy Horse Campground. The place was very nice, and everyone we met was friendly and welcoming. The bathrooms were kept very clean, which we really appreciated. The location was also great — close to everything and all the events going on in town. Overall, it was a wonderful experience and we truly loved staying there.

The only downsides were that it was very hard to get ahold of someone when trying to make a reservation, and the stickers they place on the vehicle and trailer were extremely difficult to remove. Other than that, everything was great, and we would definitely stay here again.

snippets.author: Bryan Crawford
snippets.text:
Our stay ended in a very unfortunate and unnecessary situation.
At check-in, the electrical pedestal at our assigned site was not functioning. We reported it immediately and were instructed by staff to temporarily use the power from the empty neighboring site until repairs were made. The following day, another staff member confirmed our pedestal was still not working and again directed us to continue using the adjacent outlet.
On February 12, while we were packing up in preparation to depart on February 13 as scheduled, the campground manager approached our site, shut off our power, and accused us of stealing electricity from the neighboring site. We immediately explained that we were following the instructions given to us by two separate staff members. The manager explained she did not care what her staff directed us to do. Despite that explanation — and despite staff confirming they had directed us to use that outlet — law enforcement was contacted and we were required to vacate the property within 30 minutes.
Emotions did rise during the interaction, which I acknowledge. However, from our perspective, we were following direct guidance from campground employees regarding a non-functioning utility at our assigned site.
We were not refunded for the remaining unused nights after being required to leave.
This situation appeared to stem from internal communication failures regarding site utilities and staff direction. We encourage future guests to verify utility functionality and document any instructions provided to avoid similar issues. We will never return to lake Havasu city again. No matter what they respond with to this review!

snippets.author: Lauren
snippets.text:
This place is a joke. Lady front desk rude. Gal at front entrance rude. Ask me a million questions to get a spot to charge for the night only to deny me bc of my dogs.
They are mix breed dogs look like Shepards and not allowed. Firstly, any campground with restrictions on dogs sucks.
Dogs are safer than humans. 👎🏽

snippets.author: Stefanie Lawless
snippets.text: Our site was very large, right on the lake with a beautiful view. We had power and water, but no sewer (but we knew that and that's only for the lakeview spots). The roads around the park were VERY poorly maintained, though: big potholes, unclear directions, and no road names. The staff was incredibly friendly.

snippets.author: Roy MacGregor
snippets.text: Never paid $80 to stay in a campground with no hot water in the showers, no hook or anything for a towel or your clothes, and if the floor has been cleaned in a week I’d be shocked. 9 broken machines in laundry room should have been my first clue. One of the sinks in the ladies’ bathroom is so broken the water just runs through the pipes on the floor. We are staying in I-7 for one more night and wish we weren’t.

snippets.author: Heather I.
snippets.text: Where to start?! Ok, the staff & location are nice. The rooms need updating, beds were uncomfortable & lumpy. Carpets need cleaning, balconies need to be power washed. The chair out on the balcony was absolutely disgusting (see pic) The hot tub wasn't working the 3 nights I stayed. Appears to be people living full time in rv's in the parking lot near the pool, which I was able to hear people arguing in their rv from my balcony late at night. There's a banner hanging from the building that says "now open". I assumed it was a new hotel but so not true! I requested a ground floor room when making the reservation since I am handicapped & traveling with a service animal. Upon  arrival I was given a 4th floor room and told no ground floor rooms available. Had I known that, I would have stayed elsewhere. The shower/tub faucet turned a full rotation making it hard to get the water temperature just right & needs replaced.There is one residential washer & residential dryer on the 4th floor for the entire hotel that accepts quarters. Someone left their laundry in the machine for almost 24 hours preventing others from using. My stay was challenging at best.

snippets.author: LJ
snippets.text:
We booked this a month in advance to stay at for two weeks while on Christmas break to visit family. Upon walking in, the smell of the place was terrible, very stale and dirty.

We checked in and got to our room, the sink did not work, ants on the table, dirt on the counters and table, it had not been cleaned. That’s when it got worse. We pulled the bed sheets back to inspect and saw BLOOD on the matress. BLOOD.

Immediately requested a different room, but once we got there the room was the same. Dirty all over the place, pulled up the sheets again, found hair and the mattress looked like a body had decomposed on it, was so dirty.

I booked this through booking.com and was able to cancel our reservation for only $50 and stay somewhere else.

A few days later, I got charged for the full amount of the stay, $670. I cancelled this booking on the 18th and I still have NOT got my money back.

STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE!

—-update—— 17 January 2026, still no refund and somehow a manager is never around to approve anything.

snippets.author: Jackie C
snippets.text:
This was not a good place, the pictures online were very misleading & not even close to the condition of the real rooms! The sheets & curtains were stained, paint was peeling in the bathroom shower, large hole in the patio screens. Overall very dirty! In serious need of updating & remodeling the whole place.
Would not recommend this to anyone!
We turned around & left after we looked at the dirty room.

snippets.author: Mary Trevino
snippets.text: First, I find out the Jacuzzi isn’t working and they stated they would have it up and running, Paying a couple hundred dollars to find out that the amenities that are being falsely advertised aren’t openly available to the guest is extremely off-putting, after walking by again there is now a health inspector paper On the pool gate, so I’m not sure if they’re currently in violation Especially because I still see guest being able to go into the gate, just not use the water, but I would think that the manager would contact me since I left my number at the front desk over three days ago. Very unprofessional I’ll be messaging studio six corporate.

snippets.author: Jessica McCoy
snippets.text: I have never left a review for any place before but this was by far the worst place I’ve stepped into. We made a booking on a whim and upon walking into the room turned right around and could not stay. This place smells so bad and is so dirty. The bed was missing parts of the sheet set, dresser falling apart, blinds falling apart, toilet cover wasn’t on and so many things broken. I highly recommend NEVER staying here, even for free!!

snippets.author: Brian Dady
snippets.text: First off, nothing wrong with the room, clean well maintained and had a functional kitchenette. The service was excellent, the mattress wasnt garbage and the continental breakfast was well above average. Booked through the hotel, price we paid was the price we were quoted and the deposits were returned promptly. Staff was polite and helpful and the amenities were all stocked up, early check in was uncomplicated and fair ($25) A/C worked and there were no "hotel smells". One of the most pleasant hotels stays we've had in a while.

snippets.author: Robin Henderson
snippets.text:
The reason for the two stars is because we stayed here a couple of years ago and everything was great!
This time though we didn't get any rest because the mattress was not comfortable at all and the living area furniture was just as bad!  We tried watching TV the first night and found that two occasional chair in the room was like sitting on a piece of lumber with material over the top.
Also the bed was so uncomfortable that we both walked away with extreme back aches.
If it weren't for the furnishings being very used (as if they bought them used). This would be a great hotel.  The staff is very friendly and helpful.
They have a continental breakfast with good choices and we love the price and location.  I guess you get what you pay for. 😕

snippets.author: Sally Ragusa
snippets.text:
The room was clean and quiet. Nice size. Our room featured a king bed, refrigerator, microwave and a shower with a tub.  The hot tub area was nice as well.
The staff were very friendly and pleasant,  room rates were very reasonable. I will definitely stay here again.

snippets.author: Don Zulaica
snippets.text: Exceptional value. Simple, but well-appointed rooms (with kitchenette, fridge, microwave, etc.) that are very clean. Very close to London Bridge, so it's in a good location-- close to all manner of food and grocery stores. However, the kicker is the service. One evening we got in very late, with some good leftover protein in tow, and we asked the front desk worker if they had any bagels left over from breakfast. This young person, believe her name was Ember (apologies if misspelled), not only gave us fresh bagels, she plated them with butter and cream cheese. One of the best midnight snacks we've ever had. When we return to LHC we will stay there.

snippets.author: Lucas Fowler
snippets.text:
I stopped here for a night because of the heated pool. I liked it here so much, I extended my stay for a couple more nights, and now I've come back for a month!

The staff is great, very nice and friendly. Always helpful, and some of them are even wonderfully chatty, if you're inclined to be social.

Although the rooms have kitchenettes, you'd never know they're used much. The rooms are very, very clean. And very comfortable, too!

I've been able to settle in nicely for my month stay, and I'm absolutely loving the heated pool, which is what caught my attention in the first place.

I've been traveling a lot, lately. By far, this is my favorite hotel I've stayed in for years!

snippets.author: Samantha Burrell
snippets.text: We just spent a wonderful week at this property.  There is so many additional entertainment and extra activities on property to do. The staff is above friendly and helpful.  Very kind to everyone including kids. The property is extremely clean and beautiful. Very close to shopping, parks, and a wonderful beach with a skate park and playground.

snippets.author: lawrence05
snippets.text: We spent a great week in a two bedroom unit at Havasu Dunes Resort. The office staff was very accommodating in that due to a fall, I requested a ground floor unit at the last minute. The resort is very well kept with metal art decor breaking up the architecture. There is covered parking near the unit. The unit itself is also pristine with sufficient amenities both in the kitchen & bathrooms. If we ran out, the office replaced. Unfortunately, we were unable to use the pool, but it looked lovely. Our location was perfect! We would highly recommend this resort.

snippets.author: Jessica Maloy
snippets.text: Great resort. Sidney was helpful at the front desk getting us checked in quickly and offering fun things to do. The room was comfy and clean. The pools even had handicap lifts. We're excited to come back.

snippets.author: T M
snippets.text: Staff was very kind from the woman on the phone to the security gaurd and front desk guy,I felt welcomed and safe. They have chromecast for streaming and complementary laundry on site. We will definitely come back to stay again.

snippets.author: Karen Kirn
snippets.text: The most pleasant check in experience ever! Room was ready early and exceeded my expectations for cleanliness, view and pool. Uber was quick and easy for our trips off site.

snippets.author: Brandy Glowac
snippets.text: This is a wonderful Motel!! The rooms are very clean, the bed is extremely comfortable. The Staff, especially Katherine was very kind and helpful!! The views are amazing and the pool is very nice and well kept. I recommend anyone visiting Lake Havasu looking for a decent room rate to stay at this location!!

snippets.author: Mikael van Loon
snippets.text: What  great find !! Very reasonably priced and a pool that was absolutely spic and span. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The property is being remodeled and has a first class look way above its grade. All the finishes are all top drawer. The bathroom facilities are first rate and the beds are very comfortable. The location is only a few minutes walk from the London Bridge along the easy to get to  shoreline walkway.  Definitely 5 stars on this property.

snippets.author: Peachyone
snippets.text: Great location. Extreme budget hotel. Room under $100 that's it. They were just remodeled but I felt like I was staying in a shoe box. Very bare bones. When we walked in the door there was a strong odor of fresh paint and some type of adhesive. My eyes were watering from the strong smells. It was cute inside as though they were trying to make it an upper end room that was trendy but it just fell flat. All very cheap. They didn't replace the shower pan & shower stall so it's all rusted and filthy. The lobby is being remodeled so check in was located in one of the rooms. I'm sorry this is just too cheap. I'm glad we only stayed one night. The town is super cute, I would come back but stay somewhere else.

snippets.author: RoadDogmom
snippets.text: 5 star service. Thank you Desiree and the lady whom worked during the day.  My friend Janey booked a room through Airbnb and I met her in town.  They Even let me charge up the van in the parking lot.  We enjoyed it so much while the festival was going on that we stayed another night.  Clean rooms. Nice hot shower.  Outdoor pool.  They're doing renovations so it was a bit cluttered outside but there was no disturbing noises or anything like that.  We'll be back.

snippets.author: matthew hawe
snippets.text:
I would have given this place five stars based on the location alone, but unfortunately this was one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve had.

The walls are incredibly thin with almost no insulation. You can hear everything happening in the neighboring rooms—conversations, doors, people moving around, everything.

I traveled here for a bike race and got almost no sleep the night before because of the noise. The second night was even worse. A neighbor was pounding on the walls, slamming doors, and trying to start a fight with another guest. The police were called and showed up around 12:30 AM.

Overall it completely ruined my experience coming out here for the race. I would not stay here again.

10/10 do not recommend.

name: Super 8 by Wyndham Lake Havasu City

snippets.author: shmedlie hanches
snippets.text:
I was a HEAVY traveler fo business for about 4” years. I flew and stayed in all 49 states. All ways being on a fat corporate travel budget, I stayed in the best of the best, everywhere, always. I was GOLD level and higher with all the major chains. I was Platinum with Planet Hollywood in Vegas as an example.

Okay… Super 8 was certainly not even in my vocabulary back then, but now that I’m retired and on my own expense account, the old ways are gone. I’m careful about expenses. I chose Havasu Super 8 based upon the web site pictures and price.  I expect that the pictures did not speak the truth and that the price would.

NOPE! I’m blown away.  The pictures are accurate, the facility is CLEAN CLEAN CLEAN!! Just as clean as any of the mega chains at 5-times the price throughout the nation!

Pool and hot tubs. PERFECT!
Rooms: both room I had were perfect!
Tv and its channel selection: AWESOME!
Ice and vending machines CLEAN!!!!
Staff: beyond friendly and helpful! It’s owner operated. That means a LOT.
Bed and Mattress and sheets etc. PERFECT!
Bathroom: CLEAN!  Towels-THE BEST!
I love this place! It will be my only hotel in Mohave County!  Not kidding!

snippets.author: Jenna
snippets.text:
READ THE BAD REVIEWS HERE & BELIEVE THEM!! BEDBUGS & ROACHES

We had the worst experience here! This was the dirtiest hotel I've ever been to and I wish we would have left sooner! We found a roach all 3 days we stayed. We should have left sooner but I was just trying not to be a complainer, however, on our last morning (we stayed 3 days in a filthy room), I saw a bedbug scurrying across the bed I was sleeping in!!! To say I shrieked was an understatement before I went to smash the sucker! I have attached photos to this review starting with the bedbug, 1 of the roaches we were able to catch and kill, out of 3, and some of the state of the room when we came in. We should have taken more pictures but we just wanted out of there asap that morning considering myself and my family member both had 5 and 12 hr drives back to our places of residence and now we needed to bag up and treat our luggage to top things off.

Read the bad reviews here and BELIEVE THEM!!
When we went to front desk to complain about how unacceptable this is as now we had to go through the extra steps to treat our luggage to ensure we didn't bring any passengers home, it came off as they know of the problems, that we have to submit proof /pictures if we wanted a refund AND we needed to call in the next day to speak with management because there was nothing front desk could do for us.

Please see attached photos. Check your rooms. I didn't find bed bugs in the seams of the bed but I didn't think to look at headboards after looking up how to check for more bedbugs.

Avoid this place at ALL costs!!! This is not what you want to deal with when you've driven 12 hours and need a place to rest.

snippets.author: Pastor Mitch Murray
snippets.text: This place was a dream come true..budget friendly ..lake front views.nice hot tub..and the front desk guy Mario was amazing. Helpful with our kids and getting moved in, welcoming ,and letvus know where the good food spots were. He treated us like family

snippets.author: Jason Chaney
snippets.text: The room was dirty, not well maintained, and there was a cockroach crawling across one of the beds. The employee at the front desk was very understanding that we didn't want to stay there, and offered us a refund. Unfortunately, he was unable to refund it because we used a third party site to book the hotel, who doesn't want to refund it either. I would stay away from this hotel if you don't like bugs.

snippets.author: John Faur
snippets.text:
The hotel room my fiance stayed in was infested with BED BUGS!!.
She complained to staff and left immediately. The staff member didn’t seem to care too much.
If you plan on staying here, approach with caution.
